explicit_heun: FUSE_SOLVE(B_IMPOSE=.TRUE., S0=STATE1_LO): BSTATE=MSTATE; ESTATE=S0; FIX_STATES(DT,ERROR_FLAG); return STATE1_LO_S
FUSE_SOLVE(CALCDSDT=.TRUE., S0=STATE1_LO_S, SOLUTION=1): FUSE_DERIV; save FLUX_1 and DYDT_1
FUSE_SOLVE(B_IMPOSE=.TRUE., S0=STATE1_HI): BSTATE=MSTATE; FIX_STATES; return STATE1_HI_S
after substeps FUSE_SOLVE(NEWSTATE=.TRUE.): M_FLUX=W_FLUX; MSTATE_EQN; UPDATSTATE

fix_states_call_placement.details: FIX_STATES mutates ESTATE and M_FLUX only. DY_DT is not recomputed inside FIX_STATES; later accepted-flux aggregation and MSTATE_EQN provide the mass-consistent full-step state.

state_storage.BSTATE: MSTATE at start of the substep
state_storage.ESTATE: candidate end state supplied through S0 to B_IMPOSE
state_storage.M_FLUX: raw or averaged fluxes, mutated in place by FIX_STATES
state_storage.ERROR_FLAG: logical output true if any state bound branch was taken
state_storage.single_architecture_hidden_fields: xtry_2_str.f90 assigns FREE_2A=missingValue twice and does not assign FREE_2B for single lower architectures; FIX_STATES WATR_2 upper test therefore reads an undefined/non-CSTATE field
state_storage.diagnostic_implication: The frozen wrapper records FREE_2B and explicitly initializes this non-CSTATE field to zero for single-state architectures after XTRY_2_STR; this makes the source's undefined upper-test input deterministic without changing active states, flux laws, or original scientific source. The source WATR_2 upper branch is therefore inactive under the documented wrapper contract.

contract.lower_bound: FRACSTATE_MIN * state capacity; FRACSTATE_MIN=1e-9 in the pinned numerix setup
contract.pass_order: one nonrecursive pass over ASSIGN_STT state order; lower-layer recomputation can update later states before their own cases
contract.mass_rule: The state correction is represented by changing the flux that caused the excess/deficit, or proportionally changing the outgoing loss fluxes. Subsequent-state values are recomputed from BSTATE and corrected fluxes.

lower.flux_changes: QSURF and EVAP_1 are changed proportionally using their sum
QPERC_12 and QINTF_1 are changed proportionally using their sum
lower.subsequent_state_recompute: Recompute lower layer using corrected QPERC_12

lower.flux_changes: QSURF, EVAP_1, QPERC_12, and QINTF_1 are changed proportionally using their sum
lower.subsequent_state_recompute: Recompute lower layer using corrected QPERC_12

upper.subsequent_state_recompute: Recompute OFLOW_2A/B and FREE_2A/B from BSTATE and corrected lower incoming flux

lower.error_loss: (ESTATE.WATR_2 - XMIN*DPARAM.MAXWATR_1)/DT (source-level upper-layer MAXWATR_1 reference is preserved)
lower.flux_changes: EVAP_2 and QBASE_2 are changed proportionally using their sum

upper.trigger: ESTATE.FREE_2B > DPARAM.MAXFREE_2B (source-level condition; it does not test ESTATE.WATR_2)

state_rules.topmdexp_2: not supported by the complete source contract: direct WATR_2 handling exists, but qperc-changing upper-layer lower-bound correction reaches the source default STOP because lower recomputation omits topmdexp_2

single_state.unlimfrc_2_unlimpow_2_overflow: OFLOW_2 is not recomputed by this block

flux_finalization.parallel_architecture: After the state loop, QBASE_2=QBASE_2A+QBASE_2B and OFLOW_2=OFLOW_2A+OFLOW_2B
flux_finalization.derivative: FIX_STATES does not call MSTATE_EQN; corrected M_FLUX is later consumed by WGT_FLUXES/MSTATE_EQN
flux_finalization.snow: Snow is updated by UPDATE_SWE and is not a CSTATE processed by FIX_STATES
flux_finalization.routing: Routing states are not in CSTATE and are not processed by FIX_STATES

status_flags_and_quirks.error_flag: initialized false, set true for any lower or upper correction, no iteration or recursion
status_flags_and_quirks.error_fields: one ERR_* field per state receives the last ERROR_LOSS value after that state's lower/upper checks
status_flags_and_quirks.division: proportional lower corrections divide by TOTAL_LOSS without a source guard; the PyTorch equivalent must define only the zero-denominator extension needed for finite compiled execution
preserved_source_quirks: WATR_2 lower ERROR_LOSS uses DPARAM.MAXWATR_1 while the clipped lower bound uses MPARAM.MAXWATR_2
WATR_2 upper branch tests FREE_2B instead of WATR_2 and then clips WATR_2
lower recomputation uses BSTATE rather than current ESTATE
FIX_STATES emits debug prints if QSURF is negative
